It is completely understandable that you are struggling to move on, especially since he is still giving you mixed signals through physical touch and checking you out. When you have strong feelings for someone, trying to immediately transition back to a platonic friendship is incredibly difficult, and it is natural that his affection is keeping your hope alive. 

To get him out of your system, you may need to establish clearer boundaries. Since his hugs and touches are fueling your fantasies, it is okay to gently ask him to dial back the physical affection. You might also consider taking a temporary step back from the friendship. Giving yourself some real space—limiting your conversations and hangouts for a little while—can provide the emotional distance you need to heal. Once your feelings have truly settled, you can reevaluate if maintaining the friendship is possible and healthy for your own well-being.
